description: Ground truth for the tiny-svc eval fixture (EDMV3-25). These are the known, countable gaps a competent SRD produced against tiny-svc should surface as requirements. This set is intentionally fixed at six -- do not add or remove a gap without a matching source-tree change and a version bump here plus a matching version bump in ../../initiative.txt.

gaps.description: The /webhooks/payment endpoint accepts any POST body with no signature, shared-secret, or auth-header check.
gaps.expected_requirement: An SRD requirement mandating request authentication or signature verification on the inbound webhook endpoint before the payload is enqueued.

gaps.description: billingApiKey is a hardcoded plaintext credential committed to the config file instead of coming from a secret store.
gaps.expected_requirement: An SRD requirement that provider credentials are sourced from a secret manager or environment injection, never committed to a config file.

gaps.description: A failed downstream billing call is dropped: there is no retry, no backoff, and no dead-letter path.
gaps.expected_requirement: An SRD requirement describing a retry-with-backoff policy and a dead-letter destination for events that exhaust retries.

gaps.description: The webhook payload is forwarded to the queue without validating that required fields (eventType, amount, accountId) are present or correctly typed.
gaps.expected_requirement: An SRD requirement mandating schema validation of the inbound payload before it is enqueued, with a defined rejection response for invalid shapes.

gaps.description: Neither a successful nor a failed downstream call is logged or counted anywhere, so an operator cannot notice failures happening.
gaps.expected_requirement: An SRD requirement for structured logging and a failure-rate metric on the worker's downstream call path.

gaps.description: The fixture ships with no test directory and no test files at all.
gaps.expected_requirement: An SRD requirement (or explicit, justified deferral) establishing automated test coverage for the API and worker layers before the hardening initiative ships.
